Made by a family

The story behind the AZoomals

AZoomals is written by Martin Aspinall and illustrated by his sister, Louise Pyke. It was inspired by Harper and Hudson, and the books end with a drawing by one of the children who inspired them.

Questions

Good to know

Is the app really free?

Yes. AZoomals ABC is free to play in any web browser on a phone or tablet, with no sign-up and no adverts.

When are the books out?

Season 1 is written. Release dates are announced to the launch list first, so join to hear before anyone else.

Who is it for?

Children aged 5 and up who are learning their letters, and anyone who loves a big cast of funny characters to root for.

Where can I buy things?

The shop opens alongside Book 1. Tap the things you'd like in the shop section and you'll be told the moment they're ready.
